ATLDN.name: Aloft Atlanta Downtown
ATLDN.description: For both business trips and leisure getaways, this upscale hotel provides vibrancy and style worth celebrating. Guests will relish this hotel's loft-like rooms, free Wi-Fi, on-site dining, live music, fitness center and location near Georgia Aquarium.

ATLDO.name: Courtyard Atlanta Downtown
ATLDO.description: In the historic Carnegie Building, Courtyard Atlanta Downtown offers boutique charm and sophisticated amenities. Guests will enjoy the hotel's spacious rooms, event space and an ideal location near Centennial Park, Georgia Aquarium and State Farm Arena.

ATLDT.name: Residence Inn Atlanta Downtown
ATLDT.description: The Residence Inn Atlanta-Downtown is a historic conversion property of the Rhoades and Haverty building originally built in 1928. It's listed on the National Registry for Historic Places and exudes the character and charm of a bygone era.

ATLMQ.name: Atlanta Marriott Marquis
ATLMQ.description: Select Atlanta Marriott Marquis for a memorable stay. Our downtown hotel boasts a modern design, spacious rooms, multiple restaurants and bars, a spa, indoor/outdoor pool and over 160,000 square feet of comprehensive business facilities and event venues.

ATLPK.name: Twelve Downtown, Autograph Collection
ATLPK.description: Located in Atlanta, Twelve Downtown, Autograph Collection serves to impress with condo-style suites featuring curated décor and discerning amenities. The hotel boasts a restaurant, outdoor pool, 24/7 fitness center and state-of-art event venues.

ATLPL.name: The Westin Peachtree Plaza, Atlanta
ATLPL.description: Choose The Westin Peachtree Plaza, Atlanta, with city views from floor-to-ceiling windows in each guest room, award-winning dining and 360° views from the iconic Sun Dial Restaurant, over 80,000 square feet of event space and a host of upscale amenities.

ATLRZ.name: The Ritz-Carlton, Atlanta

ATLTE.name: Ellis Hotel, Atlanta, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
ATLTE.description: Elevate your stay in Atlanta, Georgia at Ellis Hotel, Atlanta, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel. This hotel in a historic building near Mercedes-Benz Stadium boasts chic rooms, complimentary Wi-Fi, a 24-hour fitness center and meeting space.

AUSBR.name: Downright Austin, A Renaissance Hotel
AUSBR.description: Welcome to Downright Austin, downtown’s newest hotel—just steps from the University of Texas and the State Capitol! With 367 bold, inviting rooms and suites, guests enjoy skyline views and a stay that reflects the city’s vibrant, casually chic spirit.From standout style to signature hospitality, we’re your urban oasis—within walking distance of 6th Street nightlife, the UT campus and stadium, the Moody Center, and iconic venues like Mohawk, Waterloo, and Stubb’s.Don’t miss Swim Club—our historic pool turned retro-inspired restaurant, bar, and lounge. Colorful and full of flavor, it sits beside our perfectly pink pool and the lush Lawn. It’s the ideal spot to sip, socialize, and soak up the Austin vibe.Planning an event? We offer 40,000+ sq ft of indoor and outdoor space, including the Capitol Ballroom for up to 1,000 guests, plus flexible breakout rooms and open-air venues.Check in to the hotel that’s absolutely, positively, Downright Austin – a Renaissance Hotel.

AUSCD.name: Courtyard Austin Downtown/Convention Center
AUSCD.description: Courtyard Austin Downtown/Convention Center is an urban oasis offering free Wi-Fi, on-site dining and eight event venues. This hotel is one block from Austin Convention Center and moments from The University of Texas and lively nightlife on 6th Street.

AUSDA.name: Aloft Austin Downtown

AUSJW.name: JW Marriott Austin
AUSJW.description: In the heart of the city, JW Marriott Austin offers effortless elegance and sophisticated amenities. Guests will enjoy the hotel's spacious rooms, luxury suites, on-site restaurants, and ideal location near Sixth Street and South Congress Avenue.

AUSMD.name: Austin Marriott Downtown

AUSRD.name: Residence Inn Austin Downtown/Convention Center

BNAAC.name: AC Hotel Nashville Downtown

BNAJW.name: JW Marriott Nashville

And enjoy your favorite cocktail in our cozy lobby lounge and bar. Personalized, engaging, dedicated to quality and sitting 21 stories above street level, The LaSalle Chicago is above it all and above all expectations.

FLLAA.name: Aloft Fort Lauderdale Airport
FLLAA.description: Welcome to Aloft Fort Lauderdale Airport & Cruise Port—your starting point for business, travel, or a well-earned getaway. Take in panoramic city views from our 14th-floor rooftop, where you’ll find a refreshing pool and cocktail bar—ideal for unwinding or catching up with friends. Inside, the open-concept lobby invites connection, with bold design, flexible workspaces, and live music at the WXYZ® Bar. Each guest room features a sleek, loft-inspired layout with floor-to-ceiling windows and vibrant views. Wherever you're headed next, start your stay in style at Aloft.

WASCW.description: Step into the The Westin Hotel in Washington D.C. and immerse yourself in spacious, luxury suites, modern amenities,  two delicious on site restaurants, and a state of the art fitness center. Go explore Dupont Circle right outside our doors.

WASDC.name: Residence Inn Washington, DC Downtown
WASDC.description: Located in a historic building, Residence Inn Washington, D.C. Downtown offers modern amenities, including complimentary Wi-Fi and breakfast. The hotel has a 24-hour fitness center and event space walking distance from the White House and National Mall.

WASMM.name: The Madison Hotel
WASMM.description: Le Méridien Madison, Washington, DC blends timeless elegance and modern flair, inspired by Lady Madison, the hotel’s signature restaurant. Our newly renovated guestrooms and select suites provide a peaceful retreat, ideal for both business and leisure. For an elevated experience, our penthouse suites feature expansive terraces with Capitol views. Centrally located near The White House, Fannie Mae, World Bank, IMF, and top law firms, guests are steps from iconic landmarks and DC’s power centers.

WASMV.name: Marriott Vacation Club at The Mayflower, Washington, D.C.
WASMV.description: Visit hub.vacationclub.com for current status of amenities, services, and renovations. Limited Marriott Bonvoy benefits.

WASNC.name: Courtyard Washington, DC Dupont Circle
WASNC.description: Situated on a quiet residential street yet steps from everything like Dupont Circle Red Line Metro Stop, The White House, the National Geographic Museum, St Matthew's Cathedral, charming Embassy Row, local shops and restaurants.

WASOX.name: Moxy Washington, DC Downtown
WASOX.description: The Moxy Washington, DC Downtown is a cool, relaxed, eclectic downtown hotel. With loft-like ambitions & compact, efficient accommodations, enjoy 55" HDTVs, free WiFi and bedside USB outlets. Enjoy complimentary coffee all day and Bar Moxy at night.

WASRI.name: Residence Inn Washington, DC/Dupont Circle
WASRI.description: Residence Inn Dupont Circle is  ideal  for leisure and  business travelers. Our spacious and refreshed suites,  fantastic location, complimentary breakfast and professional staff make this hotel a great value  for DC travelers.

WASSX.name: The St. Regis Washington, D.C.
WASSX.description: The St. Regis Washington, D.C. is a historic five-star hotel in the city's vibrant downtown district. Well known for its grand Italian Renaissance style lobby, the hotel features elegantly appointed rooms and suites and extraordinary on-site dining.

WASTX.name: The Ven at Embassy Row, Washington, D.C., a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
WASTX.description: Located in a neighborhood known for its art, culture, cuisine and embassies, The Ven is reflective of the vibrant personality of Dupont Circle. Offering style and international flair in a sophisticated yet comfortable environment.

WASWE.name: Washington Marriott Georgetown
WASWE.description: Guests receive a warm welcome to the nation's capital when arriving for a stay at Washington Marriott Georgetown. Our hotel boasts recently renovated rooms, memorable dining options and a location near many top D.C. destinations.
